# AMBOSS

> AMBOSS is a comprehensive digital medical knowledge and learning platform combining peer-reviewed clinical reference materials with adaptive question banks and AI-powered study tools for medical students, PA students, and physicians.

AMBOSS serves medical education across multiple specialties and exam levels, from USMLE and COMLEX board exams to clinical rotations and PA certification. The platform integrates with popular study tools like Anki and offers mobile apps, browser extensions, and AI-powered personalized learning features.

## Key Topics

- AMBOSS
- Qbank
- USMLE

## Exam Preparation

- [USMLE® Step Exam preparation: Study with AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/usmle): AMBOSS comprehensive USMLE Step 1, 2, 3 exam preparation resource
- [AMBOSS Qbank: Score higher on USMLE® and NBME® exams](https://www.amboss.com/us/students/exams): AMBOSS Qbank with 5,700+ questions for USMLE and NBME exams
- [Your comprehensive resource for COMLEX® prep: AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/comlex): AMBOSS COMLEX exam prep with osteopathic modules and 5,700+ questions
- [PANCE® Exam Prep & PA Study Resources | AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/pa/pance): AMBOSS PANCE exam prep with 1,950+ questions and clinical tools
- [Honor your rotations & score high on Shelf exams with AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/shelf): AMBOSS Shelf exam preparation with clinical study plans and Qbank
- [EOR™ Exam Prep & PA Study Resources | AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/pa/eor): AMBOSS End of Rotation exam prep for PA students with 2,000+ questions
- [USMLE® Self-Assessments for Step 1 & Step 2 | AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/usmle/self-assessment): AMBOSS USMLE self-assessments with 160 practice questions and score reports
- [The ultimate USMLE® & COMLEX® score predictor | AMBOSS](https://www.amboss.com/us/score-predictor): AMBOSS score predictor for USMLE and COMLEX exam performance

## Study Tools & Resources

- [AMBOSS: your next-gen resource for med school and beyond](https://www.amboss.com/us/students): AMBOSS student product page with Qbank, library, and Anki integration
- [Best resources in medical school: AMBOSS library, Anki add-on](https://www.amboss.com/us/students/study): AMBOSS study tools including library, Anki add-on, and board exam prep
- [Powerful learning and clinical decision support tools combined into one platform](https://www.amboss.com/us/knowledge/index): AMBOSS knowledge base with peer-reviewed clinical articles and anatomy
- [AMBOSS add-on for Anki: Flashcards & high-yield content combined](https://www.amboss.com/us/anki): AMBOSS Anki add-on integrating Qbank sessions with flashcard learning
- [AI Mode Learning: the game-changer to study medicine](https://www.amboss.com/us/ai-mode-learning): AMBOSS AI Mode Learning converts study materials into personalized content
- [AMBOSS | Product Features | Learn, Practice, Teach](https://www.amboss.com/us/features): AMBOSS product features including Qbank, checklists, calculators, analytics
